Case Study

Prescripto: Healthcare Management Reimagined

Enterprise-grade healthcare management system with doctor scheduling, EMR, and telemedicine capabilities.

{/* Details Section */}

Project Overview

Prescripto is a comprehensive MERN stack application designed to streamline healthcare operations. It provides a robust platform for doctors to manage appointments, patients to book consultations, and administrators to oversee the entire clinic ecosystem.

Key Features

  • Automated Doctor Scheduling & Appointment Management
  • Digital Electronic Medical Records (EMR) for Patients
  • Secure Telemedicine Integration for Remote Consultations
  • Prescription Management & History Tracking
  • Admin Dashboard with Analytics and User Management
